preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and have a positive weight.
The start vertex u must be a valid vertex in the graph.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum total weight of the edges and the indices of the edges in the shortest-path tree.
The number of edges in the shortest-path tree must be n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= m for index in edge_indices)
postconditions.description: All edge indices must be valid and within the range of the input edges.
